blockers.detail: The direction of added network delay (ingress, egress, or bidirectional) for configuration A is unspecified. The previous critic explicitly flagged this gap and it has not been resolved.
blockers.required_input: Explicit delay direction (ingress / egress / bidirectional) for the netem or iperf configuration under which the 12 ms claim was produced.

blockers.detail: No replication unit is defined. Without a specified replication unit (e.g., independent socket connection, separate process launch, distinct host pair), run independence cannot be established and inferential coverage of the 12 ms figure is impossible.
blockers.required_input: Definition of the replication unit: what constitutes one independent observation of flow_completion_time_ms under configuration A.

input.reason: The claim asserts a specific flow completion time (12 ms) under "fixed configuration A," but critical design parameters remain unresolved from the previous critic rejection: (1) the direction of added delay (ingress, egress, or both) is unspecified, and (2) there is no defined replication unit to establish independence between runs. No registered check covers this claim, and the available runners (emulated-netem-v1, real-world-iperf-v1) cannot be used without these parameters. The source is synthetic with no real paper, so no authoritative values can be extracted. These are fixable design gaps, not equipment or authorization issues.
